<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 24:3">Targ. Y. Deut. XXIV, 3</cite> <he>אַכְרִיזוּ וכ׳</he> it has been announced (decreed) in heaven.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:5">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>מר זוטרא מלקי ומַכְרִיז</he> M. Z. punished (a woman for being closeted with a man) and published the fact (in order to protect her children’s legitimacy).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a">Ib.</cite> <he>אי לאו דקא מַכְרִיזֵי</he> (<he>מַכְרְזֵי</he>) <he>וכ׳</he> if it had not been called out in heaven, Beware of R. M. &c.
